Alex (Docs): Heads up — PR #3421 is blocked in the merge queue, linkchecker found a 404 in the console observability sample. Can someone triage? /cc @Mira
Mira (Console): Which file / link? short note so we can unblock.
Alex (Docs): It's the sample under docs/console/observability/samples/kvcache.md. The sample points to an internal runbook URL that 404s and uses an out-of-date metric name in the example: `redwood.kv.latency_ms`. CI fails at linkchecker.
Jamal (Observability): I can take this after stand. Do we have a public alternative for the runbook?
Alex (Docs): Proposed quick fixes: 1) replace internal runbook with public https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/kv-cache 2) update metric in sample to `redwood.kv.cache_latency_ms` and add an alias so existing dashboards don't break.
Mira (Console): Sounds good. Can you open a tiny branch/PR with both small edits so we only rerun linkchecks once? I'll queue it for a docs reviewer.
Sophia (SRE): I'll validate the metric rename. Small ask: add a note in the dashboard-mapping.yaml to alias `redwood.kv.latency_ms` -> `redwood.kv.cache_latency_ms` or add a prometheus rename rule. Otherwise dashboards will show gaps.
Alex (Docs): Will add alias mapping + PR description that calls out dashboards. Checklist I'll include in PR: - replace link, - update sample metric, - add alias in dashboard-mapping.yaml, - add a minimal linkchecker test so we don't regress. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3421
Jamal (Observability): After alias is in, I'll run the dashboard smoke test locally and report back. If green, Mira can merge. :thumbsup:
